ref2_mri_t1: Magnet and radio waves. On a conventional T1-weighted image, fat is often bright and simple fluid dark. MRI uses no ionizing radiation.
ref2_mri_screening: CT is often used for rapid assessment of suspected acute skull injury and bleeding. MRI requires safety screening: implants and devices must be identified and their MR safety conditions checked.
